rca of the issue: advisor/chat 500 RCA: _build_context loads ai_systems from Mongo and unconditionally accesses a['drift']. The new /api/ai-systems/discover route inserts records ({ref,name,status,risk_class,provider,owner,nist_profile,discovered,confidence,exposure,models,sources,created_at}) with NO 'drift' key. Once the review request's shadow-discovery step ran, the very next advisor/chat call raised KeyError 'drift' → FastAPI 500. Fix: replace a['drift'] with a.get('drift', 0) (also switched other lookups to .get in the same list-comp for symmetry). Reproduces reliably: POST /api/ai-systems/discover then POST /api/advisor/chat before the fix → 500; after the fix → 200 SSE stream.
